The failing postcondition is at the return in the second loop, needing forall i<p, a[i]<a[p]. I realize the second loop is missing an invariant tying elements before the current index to being bounded by best, and confirming best stays equal to m since the loop body never modifies it.

So this is an insufficient invariant issue — I should add the invariant that for all j < i, a[j] <= best, which combined with existing facts should let the postcondition go through.
